Three men in Blue
Kneeling on another Black man,
Squeezing out his last breath.

One Black man kneeling, 
On a field for all,
Just to protest their death.

Of the kneelers above,
Who is really the threat?

#GeorgeFloydProtests #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/ID5hQMvj4F

I wrote this for George. 
I wrote this for humanity.
Too many have lost theirs.
This is insanity.

#GeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter

shoutouts to @shaunking @KingJames @Kaepernick7 @common and all who are raising a voice. https://t.co/JjbQ4g5ZHY
